# ExamO / 易考鸥

> AI-assisted study and exam preparation for university students. Official public product information; core source remains private.

Company and official links reviewed: 2026-10-22. Implementation review: 2026-10-20. Implemented means found in reviewed code, not verified production availability. Planning and some adaptive features require configuration. Present orchestration is user-controlled and rule-based with model assistance. Autonomous model-directed multi-tool execution and background reminders are Planned.

ExamO（易考鸥）is provided by 贵州初界计划科技有限公司 (Guizhou Chujie Plan Technology Co., Ltd.), branded as 初界计划. The official company website is https://yikaoou.cn/ and its product page is https://yikaoou.cn/examo/. The chujiejihua.cn domain is used for business email.
